t: What Diagnostic Accuracy Database Is All About
title: What Diagnostic Accuracy Database Is All About
description: Diagnostic accuracy is four numbers: sensitivity (true positive rate), specificity (true negative rate), and the predictive values that depend on prevalence. A 99%-accurate test for a 1-in-10,000 disease still yields mostly false positives — Bayes' rule governs. Mammography (~85% sensitive), rapid strep tests, and COVID PCR each trade sensitivity against specificity differently. Reference information, not medical advice. This database is the complete diagnostic test: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
